نتزحلق (form IIq)
# نَتَزَحْلَقُ (natazaḥlaqu) /na.ta.zaħ.la.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَزَحْلَقَ (tazaḥlaqa)
# نَتَزَحْلَقَ (natazaḥlaqa) /na.ta.zaħ.la.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَزَحْلَقَ (tazaḥlaqa)
# نَتَزَحْلَقْ (natazaḥlaq) /na.ta.zaħ.laq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَزَحْلَقَ (tazaḥlaqa)
